1,250 cubic meters of water were delivered to a 10-hectare farm for the month of June, in which the consumptive use is estimated at 8 mm/day. The effective rainfall for the period was 150 mm. What is the irrigation efficiency?
questions.explanation: Cu = 8 mm/day x 30 days x 1 ha = 2,400 m3. Effective rainfall = 150 mm x 1 ha = 1,500 m3. Ea = Cu - Er = 900 m3. Irrigation efficiency = 900/1,250 x 100% = 72%.

How many treatments are involved?
questions.explanation: Treatment df = Total df - Error df = 14 - 12 = 2. Number of treatments = Treatment df + 1 = 2 + 1 = 3.
